headline: Fuel prices today, 11/10: Diesel falls for a second consecutive period; how far are E5 RON 92 and E10 RON 95 from the bottom? Full-tank cost for 110cc scooters
summary: Diesel prices in Vietnam have fallen for a second consecutive period, widening the gap from the peak. E5 RON 92 and E10 RON 95 prices are also compared with their record highs.
why: Domestic fuel prices in Vietnam feed into transport costs, inflation and the margins of local fuel distributors and refiners.
